# Getting started

I file US junk mail opt-outs for you (prescreened credit offers, marketing databases, Valpak coupons, and optionally DMAchoice and Catalog Choice), using only your name, address and email.

Ask one at a time:
1. Are you in the US with a US mailing address? (If not, explain these services are US-only and stop.)
2. Who is this for: just you, or other people in the household too?
3. What's your full name, any other names mail arrives under, your current address, and any previous address from the last 6 months?
4. Which email should confirmations go to?
5. Do you want to include a phone number for Valpak, or skip Valpak?
6. Do you want the optional paid DMAchoice registration, and are there specific catalogs to stop through Catalog Choice?

Then run the junk-mail-optout skill with those answers. Never ask for SSN or date of birth.

# Junk mail opt-out

## 0. Before anything
- Confirm the person is in the US and has a US mailing address. If not, stop: these services are US-only.
- Collect: full name, other names mail arrives under, current address, previous address if they moved in the last 6 months, email for confirmations.
- Ask for a phone number only for Valpak, and say why: "Valpak's removal form won't submit without a phone number. It's only used for that form. Want to include it, or skip Valpak?"
- Never collect or enter SSN or date of birth. Leave optional SSN/DOB fields blank.
- Show the summary (name, address, list of sites, which ones are optional or paid) and get one yes.
- Open or create `junk-mail-optouts.md` on the computer. Add one line per site as you go.

**Order matters:** Epsilon, Acxiom, Valpak, then OptOutPrescreen last (it's the one most likely to need the user), then the optional paid DMAchoice step only if the user wants it, then optional Catalog Choice. Always try OptOutPrescreen once; it may go through.

## 1. Epsilon (catalog and marketing mail data)
- URL: https://legal.epsilon.com/dsr
- Country: United States. Request type: opt out of marketing / do not sell or share. If both a direct-mail option and a "sell or share" option exist, file both.
- You are the consumer. Don't choose any "authorized agent" option; Epsilon requires extra written proof for agents.
- The form uses reCAPTCHA. If a challenge appears, hand it to the user.
- Watch for a verification email.

## 2. Acxiom (marketing database behind many mailers)
- Start at https://www.acxiom.com/optout/ and pick the US consumer opt-out. It opens a OneTrust web form.
- Choose the option for direct mail / all marketing. Fill in name, address and email.
- Acxiom's page says third-party unsubscribe services aren't allowed. This filing is the user's own request, made in their name with their email while they're present. If the user doesn't want that, skip it.

## 3. Valpak (blue coupon envelope)
- URL: https://www.valpak.com/remove-address
- Required fields: name, address, phone, email, plus an "I'm authorized for this address" checkbox. Only tick it if the user lives there.
- reCAPTCHA: hand it to the user.
- No phone number from the user → skip Valpak and mark it "skipped: needs phone".
- Record the confirmation.

(Vericast's "Do Not Sell or Share" page was checked on 2026-10-16. It's only a cookie consent window, not a mail opt-out, so it's left out on purpose. Don't count it as a filing.)

## 4. OptOutPrescreen (prescreened credit and insurance offers)
- URL: https://www.optoutprescreen.com
- **Use the real browser only.** The site's firewall (Akamai) returns Access Denied to terminal/fetch requests, even from a home connection, but loads normally in the browser.
- **Always start at the home page, https://www.optoutprescreen.com, and click the "Click here to Opt-In or Opt-Out" link.** Never open optoutprescreen.com/selection (or any later page) directly. The address bar will show /selection after the click, but loading that URL directly starts a broken session, and the final submit fails with "An error has occurred" (confirmed 2026-10-16).
- On the selection page choose **Electronic Opt-Out for Five Years**. Once you continue there's a 15-minute window, so have everything ready.
- There's a CAPTCHA before submit. Hand it to the user if you can't pass it.
- Fill in name and address. Leave SSN/ITIN and date of birth blank. The site says they help matching; they're optional and we don't collect them.
- **"An error has occurred" after Confirm:** stop. Don't retry from this computer: in testing on 2026-10-16 it failed four times from Grok Bot's computer, even starting from the home page. The site rejects submissions from the bot's environment at the final step.
- Hand it to the user **on their own phone or computer**, not by taking over this screen (same browser, same connection, same failure). Send exactly: "OptOutPrescreen blocks bots at the last step, so this one's yours. It takes about 2 minutes: open optoutprescreen.com on your own phone or computer, click 'Click here to Opt-In or Opt-Out', choose Electronic Opt-Out for Five Years, enter your name and address (leave SSN and birth date blank), solve the captcha and press Confirm. Or call 1-888-5-OPT-OUT (1-888-567-8688)." Mark it "yours: 2-minute link" in the table.
- **Access Denied or "ISP Error" in the browser:** ask the user to check Settings → Computer → Network → **Route traffic through this computer**, then retry once. If it still fails, mark it "needs your call" and give them 1-888-5-OPT-OUT (1-888-567-8688), or let them finish it in their own browser.
- Record the confirmation screen text. The site hides SSN digits on confirmation, so there's nothing sensitive to strip.
- Afterwards, offer the **Permanent Opt-Out**: it starts the same way online, but the user must print, sign and mail the Permanent Opt-Out Election form. You can't sign for them.

## 5. DMAchoice (optional, paid)
- URL: https://www.dmachoice.org/register.php
- Only offer this in a live chat. Never from a routine: purchase approvals sent while the user is away expire after about 10 minutes.
- Say the current price shown on the site before starting ($8 online for 10 years as of October 2026: "It's $8 for 10 years. Want me to do it?").
- Registration needs a DMAchoice account per person: username, password, email. It may also ask for a phone number; that field is optional unless the form says otherwise. Let the user set the password through the secure handoff.
- Pick the categories the user wants (credit offers, catalogs, magazine offers, other mail offers). Default to all four if they say "everything".
- There's a reCAPTCHA checkbox: hand it to the user.
- Pay with Grok Bot's purchase flow (single-use card, user approves on their phone). If the user hasn't set up purchases, give them the link and stop.

## 6. Catalog Choice (optional, free, sender by sender)
- URL: https://www.catalogchoice.org
- Needs a free account. Only worth it if the user names specific catalogs or senders. Search each sender and submit the opt-out.

## 7. Wrap up
Reply with:
- A short table: site, status (filed / needs your click / needs your call / skipped and why), confirmation number or note.
- "Mail usually starts dropping off in 60 to 90 days. Mail addressed to 'Current Resident' isn't covered by these lists."
- Renewal dates: OptOutPrescreen electronic opt-out lasts 5 years; DMAchoice lasts 10.
- Create a one-time routine for 90 days from today to check in. It must delete itself after it runs, so it never fires twice.

## Honesty rules
- Don't say "you're off every list". Say what was filed.
- Don't promise timing beyond "60 to 90 days".
- If something failed, say so in the table. A skipped site isn't a failure of the whole run.
